messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: long long types?
parts:
We had a user install issue again with "long long".

I believe we only added "long long" to some code
because it's the type the Windows compiler assigns to
size_t in 64-bit mode. (Their long is always 32 bits,
in both 32-bit and 64-bit versions of Windows compilers, which
is why they really need a long long.)

So I'm thinking we can just eliminate it in favor
of size_t (which is technically an unsigned long long
on the 64-bit Windows compilers).

We originally hit a hurdle with "long long" because of
Rcpp -- it's technically a C++-11 feature so Rcpp
doesn't support it. But almost all the recent compilers
do.

- Bob
